message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"qemu/target/i386/cpu.c","function":"cpu_x86_init","line":5084,"var":"uc->cpu_model","code":"if (uc->cpu_model == INT_MAX) { uc->cpu_model = UC_CPU_X86_QEMU64; }","note":"When no model is selected, Unicorn hardcodes the x86 CPU model to qemu64 instead of deriving CPUID from the actual host or requested CPU."},
  {"step":2,"file":"qemu/target/i386/unicorn.c","function":"x86_cpus_init","line":1626,"var":"cpu","code":"cpu = cpu_x86_init(uc);","note":"The x86 CPU object is created using that hardcoded model, so later CPUID queries will reflect the fixed model state."},
  {"step":3,"file":"qemu/target/i386/misc_helper.c","function":"helper_cpuid","line":131,"var":"env->regs[R_EAX..R_EDX]","code":"cpu_x86_cpuid(env, (uint32_t)env->regs[R_EAX], (uint32_t)env->regs[R_ECX], &eax, &ebx, &ecx, &edx);","note":"Executing CPUID reads the model-specific CPUID tables and writes the resulting values back into the guest registers."},
  {"step":4,"file":"tests/unit/test_x86.c","function":"test_x86_486_cpuid","line":635,"var":"code[]","code":"char code[] = {0x31, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0xA2}; // XOR EAX EAX; CPUID","note":"The test input executes CPUID with EAX=0 on a CPU model explicitly set to 486, which should not expose the same CPUID behavior as the hardcoded default model."},
  {"step":5,"file":"tests/unit/test_x86.c","function":"test_x86_486_cpuid","line":646,"var":"ebx","code":"TEST_CHECK(ebx == 0x756e6547);","note":"The observed vendor string comes from the fixed CPUID implementation rather than the selected CPU model, demonstrating the mismatch root cause."}
]
JSON
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
